metadata.title: Emmanuel Galadima — Injiniyan Software na Full-Stack AI
metadata.description: Ina tsara da gina tsarin software masu wayo da shirye don samarwa — injiniyan full-stack, AI, da gine-gine mai kula da tsaro.

hero.description: Ina tsara da gina tsarin software masu wayo da shirye don samarwa — injiniyan full-stack, AI, da gine-gine mai kula da tsaro.

about.title: Game da Ni
about.subtitle: Injiniya da farko. Tsaro a matsayin wani ɓangare na gine-gine, ba abin da ake tunani a baya ba.
about.description: Ni injiniyan software na full-stack ne da ke juya ra'ayoyin samfura masu rikitarwa zuwa tsarin aiki masu shirye don samarwa. Ina aiki a duk faɗin stack — gaba, baya, APIs, bayanai, haɗin AI, da turawa — kuma ina ɗaukan tsaro a matsayin wani ɓangare na gine-gine maimakon tunani a baya. Daga dandamalin da AI ke tafiyar da su da sarrafa takardu masu nau'ikan kafofin watsa labarai zuwa ababen more rayuwa na baya masu tsaro da aikace-aikacen blockchain, ina gina tsarin wayo, masu juriya, da tsara don isarwa.

capabilities.title: Iya Aiki

projectsData.title: Dandalin AI na Gini & Ƙididdigar Adadi
projectsData.description: Dandalin AI na farko wanda ke karanta zane-zane da PDF, yana yin ƙididdigar adadi da AI ke taimakawa, kuma yana sarrafa tsarin ayyukan gini.
projectsData.outcome: Sarrafa takardu masu nau'ikan kafofin watsa labarai, tsarawa da wakilan AI, yanayi mai dorewa, da gine-ginen bayanai a cikin tsarin samarwa guda ɗaya.

projectsData.title: ScribSyntax
projectsData.description: Studio da AI ke tafiyar da shi don labaran sauti da bidiyo — juya prompts da rubutun zuwa abun ciki na multimedia mai kyau.
projectsData.outcome: Tsarin samar da multimedia da AI ke tafiyar da shi tare da mu'amalar gyara mai rikitarwa.

projectsData.title: CryptoDaHausa
projectsData.description: Dandalin ilimin blockchain na gida wanda ke sa batutuwan Web3 masu rikitarwa su zama masu sauƙi ga masu sauraron Hausa.
projectsData.outcome: Gina hanyar shiga cikin blockchain, Web3, da fasahar da ba ta tsakiya ba.

projectsData.title: Shafin Kamfani & Turawa
projectsData.description: Shafin kamfani na zamani kuma na ƙwararru wanda aka tsara kuma aka tura don abokin ciniki na kasuwanci.
projectsData.outcome: Turawar samarwa wanda ya ɗaukaka matsayin abokin ciniki a intanet da ayyukansa.

projectsData.title: Shafin Kasuwanci na Musamman
projectsData.description: Shafin da aka keɓe don bukatun musamman na abokin ciniki na kasuwanci, yana nuna alama da aiki.
projectsData.outcome: Matsayin intanet mai alama da aiki wanda aka gina a kusa da bukatun abokin ciniki.

ai-construction-takeoff.title: Dandalin AI na Gini & Ƙididdigar Adadi
ai-construction-takeoff.summary: Dandalin AI na samarwa wanda ke karanta zane-zanen gini da PDF, yana yin ƙididdigar adadi da AI ke taimakawa, kuma yana sarrafa tsarin ayyuka.

problem.title: Matsalar
problem.body: Ƙididdigar adadi na gini na hannu ne, a hankali, kuma mai kuskure. Karanta zane-zane, fitar da awo, da ƙididdige adadin kayan da hannu yana ɗaukar sa'o'i kuma shine ƙugiya ga ƙungiyoyin aikin.

approach.title: Hanyar
approach.body: Na gina tsarin da ya haɗa sarrafa takardu masu nau'ikan kafofin watsa labarai tare da ƙididdigar adadi da AI ke taimakawa — karanta zane-zane da PDF, fitar da adadi da AI, da tura aikin ta hanyar tsari na wakilai da tsarin aiki.

architecture.title: Gine-gine & Injiniya
architecture.body: Aikace-aikacen full-stack tare da gine-ginen tushen bayanai don yanayi mai dorewa, matakin tsara wakilan AI, tsarin fitarwa, da mu'amala mai rikitarwa don bita da sarrafa tsarin ƙididdiga.

stack.title: Stack
stack.body: Next.js, TypeScript, Gemini don fahimtar multimodal, PostgreSQL don bayanai masu dorewa, da tsarin wakilan AI da aka tsara.

outcome.title: Sakamako
outcome.body: Samfuri na farko wanda ke nuna injiniya daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe — haɗin AI, gine-ginen bayanai, tsarawa da wakilai, da mu'amala mai amfani suna aiki tare a matsayin tsarin guda.

next.title: Abin da zan yi na gaba
next.body: Ƙara ganin zane-zane mai kyau, haɗin kai mai zurfi tare da kayan aikin sarrafa ayyuka, da ƙarin tsarin tsaro da izini mai ƙarfi tsakanin ƙungiyoyi.

faq.description: Amsoshi akan yadda nake aiki, hanyar da nake bi da AI, da yadda nake tunani akan tsaro.

items.question: Wane irin ayyuka kake ginawa?
items.answer: Tsarin software na full-stack — daga aikace-aikacen yanar gizo masu rikitarwa da tsarin da AI ke tafiyar da su zuwa ababen more rayuwa na baya masu tsaro da aikace-aikacen blockchain. Ina ɗaukan ra'ayin samfuri, in tsara gine-ginen tsarin, in gina shi, in haɗa AI da bayanai, in tura shi, kuma ina kiyaye tsaro a zuciya.

items.question: Shin kai injiniyan tsaro na intanet ne?
items.answer: Babban fifikona shine injiniyan software na full-stack. Ina gina aikace-aikace tare da tsaro a matsayin ɓangare na gine-gine — tabbatarwa, izini, rukunin tsaro, sarrafa shiga, da tsari mai tsaro — maimakon ɗaukan tsaro a matsayin tunani a baya.

items.question: Yaya kake amfani da AI a aikinka?
items.answer: Ina gina aikace-aikace waɗanda ke amfani da AI a matsayin ɓangare na samfurin — wakilan AI, sarrafa takardu masu nau'ikan kafofin watsa labarai, haɗin LLM, da tsarawa — maimakon kawai amfani da kayan aikin AI don yin shafukan yanar gizo.

items.question: Za ka iya yin aiki akan samfuri daga ra'ayi zuwa ƙaddamarwa?
items.answer: Ee. Injiniyan samfura ɗaya ce daga cikin manyan iya aikina — ɗaukar ra'ayi daga ra'ayi zuwa gine-gine, aiwatarwa, da turawa.
